- **A decrease on the same day:** Instance family dEUiFDB4IN (service pHsZR) dropped from a price of 1.35 to 0.45 on 10-20, saving about $367 a day. It looks like a new discount took effect. This lowered the account total, so it isn't a cause of the extra cost.
